question: On 6th February 2022, which of the following countries became the first to play 1000 one-day internationals (ODI) cricket?
solution:
The correct answer is __**India**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **On February 6, the Indian cricket team** made history by becoming the first team in the world to play** 1,000 One-Day Internationals.**
 
• The team has won **two ODI World Cups and one T20 World Cup**.
 
• In the 1000 ODI matches that India has played thus far, they have 519 victories.
 
• With 958 ODI matches played so far, Australia is in second place.
 
• India becomes the first team to play 1000 One-Day Internationals.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **In men's international cricket, **the Indian men's national cricket team, often known as **Team India or the Men in Blue**, represents India.
 
• The Board of Control for Cricket in India (BCCI) oversees the sport, and it is a Full Member of the International Cricket Council (ICC) with Test, One Day International (ODI), and Twenty20 International (T20I) status.
 
• In the 18th century, British sailors brought cricket to India, and the first cricket club was founded in 1792.
 
• Five major ICC tournaments have been won by India. The team has won the Cricket World Cup twice (1983 and 2011), the ICC T20 World Cup once (2007), and the ICC Champions Trophy twice (2002 and 2013), as well as finishing second in the Cricket World Cup once (2003), the T20 World Cup once (2014).
